title: 第30章 四条道路
novel_title: 御兽仙朝：我能设计进化形态
content_zh:
识海中，四道光柱，一起悬挂在那一页光树之上。

    每道光柱的尽头都有一个身影。

    罗影盯着这一幕，连呼吸都忘了。

    他翻遍了《万兽衍策》里的每一页，从没有见过进化路的尽头会出现四个分支，四个形态、

    他定了定神，强逼自己冷静下来。

    别急。

    先看。

    头一道光柱，是最亮的。

    那个身影，清清楚楚。

    六条腿、甲壳、一对短而粗的颚。

    体积比现在的小玄大了很多，背甲上隆起一个弧形，犹如一块弯曲的盾牌。

    身影的下方，有两行字。

    【筑垒蚁】

    【脱凡级】。

    同阶的进化。

    再往下就没有别的了。

    此时就可以走这条路。

    一旦他点头，白光落下之后，小玄就变成了脱凡级别的【筑垒蚁】。

    堂堂正正的进化，写在兽册上，上报县学。

    另外，因为这是跟【无惧蚁】不同的一种进化......

    可以直接进入前十的排名！

    享受特殊待遇...

    半年考核，稳了。

    而且，这绝不是一条差路。

    罗影把那个身影下方浮出来的信息，一行行地看下去，越看心里越沉。

    沉甸甸的，是分量。

    【筑垒蚁】的本命技能，由原来的【衔筑】升级到了现在的【筑垒】。

    和【赴难勇蚁】，走的是不同道路。

    【赴难勇蚁】是勇往直前。

    它是矛。

    把无畏之心灌入甲壳之中，在冲锋时可以撞击任何东西、咬碎一切。

    王健那只蚁进化之后，一节课下来就压制了半个班级的对手，靠的就是那股蛮不怕死的冲劲。

    【筑垒蚁】的特点是固若金汤。

    它是盾。

    所砌的墙壁，并非一般的泥墙。

    经过了【筑垒】灌注之后，硬度、韧性、灵力亲和力都会提升一个台阶。

    【赴难勇蚁】是攻，用命去换命。

    【筑垒蚁】拼的是守，以壁换命。

    一攻一守各有所长。

    从进化品级上看，两者相同，都是脱凡级。

    但是罗影心中清楚，同为脱凡级进化，不同的路，天花板的差别，亦很大。

    最差的那条叫作【无惧蚁】。

    脱凡级，可以达到十级，可以入一阶。

    可到了一阶就是死路。

    上面已经没有进化的可能了，终此一生，困在一阶。

    【赴难勇蚁】就不一样了。

    一阶之后还有【撼岳勇蚁】的路线。

    还能再进化，往稀有级的血脉去攀。

    王健那只蚁之所以值一百两，县学之所以嘉奖十两，就是因为这条路能走的更高。

    而【筑垒蚁】，也是这一类。

    罗影盯着那【筑垒蚁】身后延展出的光柱虚影...

    他的心中无比确定。

    一阶之后，上头还有路。

    它跟【赴难勇蚁】一样，有着一条能往上攀的路。

    可真正叫罗影心头一动的，是最底下那一行小字。

    入阶仪式：更替筑垒核材。

    他把这十个字，来来回回看了三遍。

    更替筑垒核材。

    他太清楚这意味着什么了。

    御兽升到十级之后，想入阶，就得举行入阶仪式。

    这道门槛，是世上绝大多数御兽一辈子迈不过去的坎。

    【赴难勇蚁】要入阶，得一场接一场地拼杀，拿命去磨，拿伤去换。

    把那颗无畏之心逼到极致，在生死之间撞开那道门。

    那是一条拿血铺的路，能不能过，全看命硬不硬。

    可【筑垒蚁】呢？

    它的入阶仪式，只有一桩事。

    拆了旧垒，换一种更好的核材，重新筑一座新的。

    筑垒，本就是它的本命技能。

    换料重筑，对它来说，就跟吃饭喝水一样顺当。

    别的兽，入阶是过鬼门关。

    它入阶，是搬一次家。

    罗影的呼吸变得急促起来。

    而找料、选料、配料，恰恰是御兽师的活。

    也就是说，小玄入阶这道坎高不高、险不险，不看蚂蚁。

    看御兽师。

    看罗影。

    他能找到什么样的料，小玄入阶就会有多顺利。

    入了阶之后，往上攀的路就有多宽。

    这已经是一条很好的路了。

    罗影的心里，重重跳了一下。

    可他的目光，已经转向了另外三道光柱。

    那三道光柱，比头一道暗了许多。

    柱身上的光，好像水中的月亮一样晃着，虚着，看不真切。

    每一束光柱尽头的蚁，都被一层薄雾笼罩着，轮廓也变得非常模糊。

    但是有一桩，看得清。

    三个身影，都在筑。

    跟头一个【筑垒蚁】一样，它们的姿态，都是衔料垒墙的姿态。
content_en:
In the sea of ​​consciousness, four pillars of light hang together on the page of light tree.
At the end of each beam of light is a figure.
Luo Ying stared at this scene and even forgot to breathe.
He flipped through every page in "The Evolution of Ten Thousand Beasts", but he had never seen four branches, four forms,
He collected himself and forced himself to calm down.
Don't worry.
Watch first.
The first beam of light is the brightest.
That figure is clear.
Six legs, a carapace, and a pair of short, thick jaws.
The volume is much larger than the current Xiao Xuan, and there is an arc on the back, like a curved shield.
Below the figure, there are two lines of words.
【Fortification ants】
[Extraordinary level].
Same level of evolution.
There is nothing else further down.
This is the path you can take at this point.
Once he nodded and the white light fell, Xiao Xuan turned into an extraordinary level [Fortification Ant].
The upright evolution is written in the animal book and reported to the county school.
In addition, because this is a different evolution from [Fearless Ant]...
You can directly enter the top ten rankings!
Enjoy special treatment...
After half a year's assessment, it's stable.
And, this is by no means a bad path.
Luo Ying read the information that appeared under the figure line by line, and the more he read, the heavier his heart became.
Heavy is the weight.
The natural skill of [Fortification Ant] has been upgraded from the original [Fortification] to the current [Fortification].
and [Brave Ant in Disaster] took a different path.
[Courageous ant in times of crisis] is to move forward bravely.
It's a spear.
Putting fearlessness into the carapace, you can hit anything and crush everything when charging.
After Wang Jian's ant evolved, he suppressed half of the opponents in the class in one class, relying on his unwavering drive to fear death.
[Fortification ants] are characterized by their impregnability.
It is a shield.
The walls built are not ordinary mud walls.
After the [Fortification] infusion, the hardness, toughness, and spiritual affinity will be improved to a higher level.
[Brave Ant in Disaster] It means attacking, exchanging lives for lives.
[Fortification Ants] fight to defend, trading their lives for their lives.
Each has its own strengths in offense and defense.
From the perspective of evolutionary level, the two are the same, both are extraordinary levels.
But Luo Ying knew in his heart that they were both at the transcendental level, but their paths were different, and the ceilings were also very different.
The worst one is called [Fearless Ant].
The transcendent level can reach the tenth level and can enter the first level.
But reaching the first level is a dead end.
There is no possibility of evolution above, and I will be stuck in the first level for the rest of my life.
[Brave Ant in Disaster] is different.
After the first level, there is also the route of [Shaking Yue Yongant].
It can evolve further and reach the rare bloodline level.
The reason why Wang Jian's ant was worth a hundred taels, and the reason why the county school awarded it ten taels, was because this road can go higher.
And [Fortification Ants] are also of this type.
Luo Ying stared at the shadow of the light beam extending behind the [Fortification Ant]...
He was extremely certain in his heart.
After the first level, there is still a way up.
Like [Brave Ant in Disaster], it has a way to climb up.
But what really moved Luo Ying's heart was the line of small words at the bottom.
Entry Ceremony: Replacement of fortification core materials.
He read these ten words back and forth three times.
Replacement of fortification core materials.
He knew all too well what this meant.
After the beast master reaches the tenth level, if he wants to enter the level, he must hold an entry ceremony.
This threshold is a hurdle that most beast masters in the world cannot overcome in their lifetime.
[Brave Ant in Disaster] To advance to the next level, you have to fight one after another, risking your life and getting hurt.
Push that fearless heart to the extreme and break open the door between life and death.
It is a road paved with blood. Whether you can pass it or not depends on whether your fate is tough or not.
But what about [Fortification Ants]?
Its entry ceremony has only one thing.
The old fortress was torn down, replaced with a better nuclear material, and a new one was built.
Building fortifications is its natural skill.
To it, changing materials and rebuilding is as smooth as eating and drinking.
For other beasts, entering the realm means passing through the gate of hell.
It's a step-by-step move.
Luo Ying's breathing became rapid.
Finding, selecting, and mixing ingredients are exactly the job of a beast master.
In other words, it doesn’t matter whether Xiaoxuan’s journey to the next level is high or dangerous.
Look at the Beast Master.
Look at Luo Ying.
What kind of materials he can find, Xiao Xuan will be able to enter the level smoothly.
After entering the steps, the path up is as wide as possible.
This is already a good path.
Luo Ying's heart jumped heavily.
But his eyes had already turned to the other three beams of light.
The three light beams were much darker than the first one.
The light on the pillar swayed like the moon in the water, it was faint and could not be seen clearly.
The ants at the end of each beam of light were shrouded in a layer of mist, and their outlines became very blurry.
But there is one thing that can be seen clearly.
The three figures are all building.
Just like the first [Fortification Ant], their posture is that of holding materials to build a wall.
